definitions.explanation: Food stored for use during emergencies such as natural disasters, power outages, or evacuation situations. Designed to have a long shelf life and require minimal preparation.

examples.japanese: {非常食|ひじょうしょく}を{備蓄|びちく}する。
{非常食|ひじょうしょく}の{賞味期限|しょうみきげん}を{定期的|ていきてき}に{確認|かくにん}しよう。
examples.english: Let's regularly check the expiration dates on our emergency food.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}に{備|そな}えて、{三日分|みっかぶん}の{非常食|ひじょうしょく}と{水|みず}を{用意|ようい}しておくことが{推奨|すいしょう}されている。
examples.english: It is recommended to keep three days' worth of emergency food and water in case of an earthquake.

notes: Common collocations: {非常食|ひじょうしょく}を{備蓄|びちく}する (to stockpile emergency food), {非常食|ひじょうしょく}セット (emergency food kit). Japan's frequent natural disasters make {非常食|ひじょうしょく} a common topic in daily life, especially around September 1 ({防災|ぼうさい}の{日|ひ}, Disaster Prevention Day). Typical items include canned bread, instant rice, and energy bars. Related: {保存食|ほぞんしょく} (preserved food — broader term for any long-lasting food), {携帯食|けいたいしょく} (portable food).
